description.narrative: Improved quality, relevance, effectiveness, and equity of access to secondary and tertiary education, in particular in rural and disadvantaged locations.

Completion rates for grades 6-11 students in the 150 poorest DSDs increased by 8% between 2008 and 2012. Progress/Status: Completion rate for grade 11 in 2012 = 53% (to be updated upon completion of impact evaluation study) Data Source: School census report. Project reports SLIATE reports. Actual value:

Enrollment and completion rates of SLIATE increased by 25% and 12%, respectively from 2008 to 2012. Progress/Status: Enrollment - Year 2008 - 8150 Year 2013 - 12,920 Year 2014 - 15,294 (Increased by 87.8%) (to be updated upon completion of impact evaluation study) Actual value:

Enrollment rates in secondary schools in the 150 poorest divisional secretary divisions (DSDs) increased by 8% between 2008 and 2012. Progress/Status: Total Enrollment in 2014 = 79,980 (11.9% increase) Data Source: Baseline established in 2008 (gender and ethnic group segregated data will be used). Actual value:

Secondary school's students' knowledge and skills related to HIV/AIDS and healthy life have improved. Progress/Status: 316,337 students have been trained by 31 Dec 2012 (to be updated upon completion of impact evaluation study) Data Source: Grant monitoring reports. Student survey in year 5. Base year: 2008 Baseline value: N
